\[
y = f_{\text{style}}(x),\qquad \text{out} = (1 - s)\, x + s\, y
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(x\): The input image
- \(f_{\text{style}}\): The network for one style
- \(s\): The strength

f is a network of convolutions, residual blocks with instance normalization, and upsampling layers. It was trained to make the deep features of y, in a fixed VGG network, match the feature correlations of the painting and the features of x. After training, one pass styles any image. s mixes the result with the input, our addition.
